app.name: Kalakriti
app.tagline: Craft, and the market it could never reach
common.offline: No internet — your work is saved on this phone
onb.chooseLanguageHint: You can change this any time
onb.howToStart: How would you like to start?
onb.whyMoney: Money from a sale reaches your account directly
onb.whyProof: Your authenticity certificate is issued in your name
onb.whyGroup: You can join group orders with your cluster
onb.createAccountSub: With your phone number, in a minute
onb.skip: Not now — start without an account
onb.skipSub: You can create one later; nothing will be lost
onb.guestNote: Without an account you can still take photos, write details and set a price. An account is only needed to publish, and your work stays exactly as it is.

home.emptySub: Tap the button above to add your first product
home.help: Not sure what to do? Tap here and the app will explain.
home.helpSpoken: To add a product, press the big orange button. Then take a photo and speak in your own language.
home.trendSub: Know what buyers want before you set up the loom
samuh.title: Group order
samuh.subtitle: What one artisan cannot fill, a cluster can
samuh.headline: 500 Banarasi dupattas in 45 days
samuh.buyer: Mehra Exports, Jaipur · export order · GI proof required
samuh.filled: Filled by the cluster so far
samuh.whyAloneBody: In 45 days you can make only 40 pieces. That is why this order always goes to a trader, who has the cluster make it for half the price.
samuh.whyAloneStrong: As a group you deal with the buyer directly.
samuh.splitNote: Each share was set from capacity, craft and quality history.
samuh.escrow: The money is held in escrow and paid straight to your account on delivery — no middleman.
samuh.joinedSub: {units} pieces in {days} days. Progress updates every week.
create.title: New product
create.subtitle: Everything on one page
create.takePhotoHint: If a label or price tag is visible it will be read automatically
create.craftQuestion: What kind of product is this?
create.craftHint: This lets the camera give the right advice — every craft needs something different
create.ocrNone: No text was found in the photo — you can fill in the name and price yourself, or say them out loud.
create.lowConfidence: Low-confidence guesses — not filled in automatically
create.whatHappened: What was done to the picture
create.noMic: This browser has no microphone support
create.writeWithAI: Let the AI write the listing
create.listenCheckSub: Did the AI write anything wrong?
create.floorNote: Materials plus your labour. Selling below this is a loss.
create.howMade: How was this price worked out?
create.breakdownEmpty: Press "Work out a fair price" above, or add lines yourself below.
create.mismatch: The lines add up to {sum}, but the price says {price} — a difference of {diff}.
create.mismatchNote: You can leave them different. To make them match, tap below.
create.matched: The price and the working match
create.explainYourself: Explain it in your own words (optional)
create.explainPlaceholder: e.g. real zari, took three days
create.channelsTitle: Where do you want to sell?
create.channelsNote: One tap sends it everywhere. Each marketplace wants a different format — the app converts it for you.
create.notConfiguredNote: Some chosen channels are not set up yet. The app will still try, and show you the real result — it will never show a false success.
create.loginNeededBanner: You will need an account when you send — your work will be kept.
create.noOrders: No orders yet. When someone buys from the link above, it will appear here on its own.
cam.permBody: The app needs the camera to photograph your product. The photo is checked on your phone itself.

auth.needMore: The marketplaces you chose need a little more information. Only what is genuinely required will be asked.
